Okay, I need to figure out when the Toronto Raptors last won the championship. Let me start by recalling what I know about the NBA. I think the Raptors won their first championship not too long ago. I remember something about Kawhi Leonard being on the team. 

Wait, when was that? Maybe around 2019? Let me think. I know LeBron James was with the Lakers later on, but before that, he was with the Cavaliers. Oh, right, the Raptors beat the Warriors in the finals. The Warriors had just lost Kevin Durant that season, I think. 

So the 2018-2019 season. The NBA playoffs for that season would have taken place in 2019. The finals are usually in June. So the championship would have been won in June 2019. Let me confirm: yes, the Toronto Raptors defeated the Golden State Warriors in the 2019 NBA Finals, which was a best-of-seven series. They won it in six games, with the final game on June 13, 2019. That's when they clinched the title for the first time in their franchise history. 

Before that, the Raptors never won a championship. They were founded in 1995, so they didn't have any titles before 2019. So the last time they won the championship is 2019, and it's their only championship so far. 

I should make sure there wasn't a more recent one. Let's see, the next seasons after 2019: 2020 was the Lakers, 2021 the Bucks, 2022 the Warriors again, 2023 the Nuggets. So no, the Raptors haven't won since 2019. 

So the answer should be 2019, specifically June 2019. The user asked "cuando fue la ultima vez que los raptors ganaron el campeonato", which translates to "when was the last time the Raptors won the championship". The answer is 2019.
[/Thinking]

La última vez que los Toronto Raptors ganaron el campeonato de la NBA fue en **2019**. Específicamente, conquistaron su primer (y hasta ahora único) título el **13 de junio de 2019**, al derrotar a los Golden State Warriors en las Finales por un marcador de **4-2** en la serie. 

Este logro fue histórico para la franquicia, fundada en 1995, ya que nunca antes habían levantado el campeonato. La estrella clave de ese equipo fue **Kawhi Leonard**, quien fue nombrado **Jugador Más Valioso (MVP) de las Finales**. Desde entonces, los Raptors no han repetido el título. 🏀 🏆
